required_findings.finding: The new required named UI/graphics evidence depends on _write_manifest, but that inherited writer only push_error/return on FileAccess.open failure. It neither records a failure nor checks flush/get_error/final readback. _finish uses its already computed complete parameter and can print OK and quit0 with no current final UI/source receipt, or a partial/stale persisted receipt. This is a source false-green path even when all framebuffer captures succeed.
required_findings.required_correction: For the opted-in UI path, propagate manifest open/store/flush/error/readback failure into nonzero completion, and compare the final persisted bytes to the exact intended manifest including graphics_capture, ui_contexts and all ui_frames. Preserve default non-UI policy if scope requires it; no new harness or test is required to address this source defect.

required_findings.finding: The guard verifies output preview, action hint and selected row index, but costs[longest].text is only read into recorded material_text. The selected cost label is not checked for nonempty text or a visible clipped rectangle. _shoot_ui only requires some visible text anywhere in the panel and visible row focus, so it can accept a purported cost-context frame with the recorded cost text absent from the picture.
required_findings.required_correction: Require the selected actual cost Label to exist, contain its production material text and have an on-screen/clipped visible rectangle before accepting the craft UI frame. Keep the existing panel/focus/owner and preview/hint guards. This establishes evidence coverage, not pixel readability.

verified_supported_parts: Only catalogue_survey.gd changes. UI mode requires exactly one existing destination/time, rejects unknown/duplicate ui-context values and calls the existing LOOKDEV named renderer/preset/source-SHA/fresh-output preflight. No UI invocation falls back to an empty bootstrap receipt.

Game.menu() returns the mounted production CanvasLayer; game_menu.open(tab_id) returns bool, current_tab_id and _bodies/_index exist. The six requested IDs are routed through existing open/close, preserving production refusal, input ownership/local pause and focus rules.

Map uses existing _map_state, _terrain_texture(world), _display_realm and _available_realms APIs; it requires real terrain, current realm, at least one discovered region and Cloudreach realm-tab visibility. These are fail-closed content checks, not screenshot readability/discovery gameplay proof.
Settings uses existing reset-all Controls Button only for focus/scroll, never activation. The second settings shutter requires the production Controls help text prefix among clipped visible text.

Craft finds already mounted CraftInteractable whose actual parent script is rest_point.gd, teleports via existing debug_teleport_to, checks real arbiter winning_provider/actionable state and uses the ordinary interact input poll. It never invokes the craft callback directly or grants a station, unlock, recipe, inventory or party.

RestPoint._on_craft opens its actual production craft_panel. _recipe_ids/_rows/_cost_labels are built from current _known_ids (including existing field/station eligibility), so longest selection is among the actual admitted list. Row focus drives original selection/preview, not a manufactured description.

The new _shoot_ui requires actual input_owner.current==panel/menu, is_open, visible content, descendant focus with clipped on-screen area and some real visible text. It captures the full root framebuffer after frame_post_draw, rejects existing output/image absence/wrong actual root size/save errors and marks failures. Appending failed UI-state records does not itself create green because _failures blocks final complete.

Expected UI counts are seven menu records or one craft record plus one original catalogue row; original non-UI capture path only gains an empty graphics_capture receipt key and the expected0/UI-empty check. Existing world/camera/travel/row logic is otherwise unchanged.
